post.caption:
Each eye has a blind spot where the optic nerve leaves, and you have never noticed because your brain invents the missing patch and hands it over as fact. Colour constancy does the same thing, which is why one grey square reads as two different greys. And because vision lags reality, your brain predicts forward and shows you the prediction. Illusions are not glitches. They are the prediction system caught showing its working.
